nom: ANUA Azelaic Acid Cica Skin Soothing Moisturizer

avis.titre: I have already purchased a second when it was on sale.
avis.texte: I honestly believe this has helped my adult acne more than thousands of dollars' worth of other products. Moisturizing level is on par with other Korean beauty moisturizers. Non-greasy, pleasant clean fragrance. Love the pump feature rather than dipping into a jar. 5 stars!
Nice & light with a great smell! I have very combo skin but this with the Anua sheer sunscreen is my favorite!
I have combo oily skin. This is not heavy or greasy. I really feel like it help calm my skin. It has a light smell but nothing crazy. Would recommend for ouly combo skin.
I really enjoyed this cream helps with my irritated skin. It has a smell nothing bad after a minute it goes away. Its a herbal smell nothing crazy.

This product has a VERY strong scent when first applied. It actually made my eyes tear up, and I've never experienced that with a moisturizer before. If you have sensitive skin, especially fragrance prone sensitivity, I'd avoid this. I (thankfully) didn't have any adverse reaction. While I typically love Azelaic Acid and Cica, this just isn't it for me. On the plus side, it doesn't have any pore clogging ingredients (I always check for that now). But the overwhelming scent just really turns me off, as someone with sensitive skin.
I am delighted with this product, I like how refreshing it makes my skin feel, it controls my redness a lot and is an important complement to the anua azelaic acid serum
